title: Mike the Cat
description:
Seven games. One cat. Endless runs.

Mike the Cat is a pick-up-and-play arcade collection made for quick sessions and "just one more try" moments. Choose a game from the menu and see how far Mike can go before he lands on something other than his feet.

THE GAMES

• 🐾 Jumpy Kitty: Tap to jump Mike through the gaps. Simple to learn, hard to put down.

• 🚁 Copter Cat: Mike takes to the skies. Keep him airborne and weave past obstacles.

• 🦘 Kitty Leap 3D: A full 3D runner. Time your leaps and keep moving forward.

• 🏙️ Alley Cat Dash: Race through the streets and dodge everything in your path.

• ☀️ Sunbeam Cat: Every cat's favorite thing, turned into a run. Chase the sunshine as far as you can.

• 🧗 Wall Climb Kitty: Bounce from wall to wall and climb as high as you dare.

• 🧱 Block Cat Run: Dash through a chunky, blocky world built for speed.

FEATURES

• 7 arcade mini-games in one package, each with its own controls and challenge

• Endless gameplay: every run is a new attempt at your personal best

• Collect coins as you play and watch your stash grow

• High score tracking, so there's always a number to beat

• Steam stats keep track of your progress and earn achievements 

• Bright, colorful cartoon style that's easy to jump into

• Short sessions: perfect for a five-minute break (or a five-hour one)

Mike has nine lives. You might need a few more.
description_short: Mike the Cat packs seven endless runners into one colorful collection. Run, jump, dodge and climb your way to new high scores, collect coins along the way, and discover why every run ends with "just one more try."
